author: Simon
html:
Absolutely. I don’t care much about the theoretical side — what matters is that FP offers some fantastically useful tools… immutable records, stream transformations, the idea of passing blocks of code around.

But so does OO. Objects and class hierarchies are often done badly, but the paradigm is ideal for some problems, just as old-school procedural programming has its uses. There’s a reason why most of the popular modern languages are multi-paradigm, allowing developers to avoid purism and take advantage of whatever works.
